sharedHelperFacts.currentCongress: Default parameter new Date(); formula floor((now.getFullYear()-1789)/2)+1 uses local calendar year, not UTC or January3 transition logic. New pure contracts need explicit trusted resolution context/source result, never ambient clock or model-provided authority.
sharedHelperFacts.billStatusLabel: Recognized stored status uses BILL_STATUS_META label; otherwise status??Unknown. Unknown strings are preserved; null/undefined map Unknown, empty string remains empty. Do not invent a closed persisted status enum without exact Prisma field evidence.
